thesis: The speaker argues that investors often mistakenly believe they can beat the market through careful due diligence and knowledge of money managers, whereas the reality is that most managers move in a herd and do the same things. He further contends that an investor only has a chance of achieving exceptional returns from a manager if that manager teaches something truly new and different, as otherwise the detailed work done by the manager is already known to the investor.
